annotations.title: Search Google and read the top results

description: Search Google through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and read the top results in one call: returns Google's AI Overview when there is one, each of the first `results` pages (default 3, max 5) as Markdown, and the other organic results as title, URL and snippet. Use it to answer a question from the live web. Billed as one request for the search plus one per page read.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to search from and read the pages through, e.g. 'US'.

results.description: How many top results to read (default 3, max 5).

name: search_and_read
title: Search Google and read the top results
